description: SCERT, Tamil Nadu, has launched AI and ICT training for higher secondary teachers, with nearly 6,500 PG teachers set to benefit from tools for virtual experiments, quizzes and digital learning.
body_lead: Tamil Nadu introduces AI training for higher secondary teachers in govt, aided schools SCERT, Tamil Nadu, has launched AI and ICT training for higher secondary teachers, with nearly 6,500 PG teachers set to benefit from tools for virtual experiments, quizzes and digital learning. R Published On Oct 21, 2026 at 10:38 AM IST Set ETEducation as your preferred source on Google Chennai: Teachers of Classes XI and XII at govt and aided schools were recently trained to use AI and information and communication technology (ICT) tools.
